trigger: typed operation, tool call, event cascade, or result-validation request
steps: Resolve repository, branch/worktree, owner, action authority, and exact requested proof level.
Select the declared input contract and ontology profile before any action is attempted.
Allocate runId, actionId, and correlationId and create cascade-run-context outside the repository.
Freeze input payload digest and authority scope without persisting secrets or raw customer payloads.
Dispatch only to pre-action-validation; do not call the action boundary directly from intake.
failure: Missing contract, ontology profile, authority declaration, or identity produces a typed blocked/rejected handoff; it does not fall through to execution.
proofCeiling: Run identity and declared contracts only; no input validity, action execution, result validity, or successor delivery.
